column2: Provisioning fails because of an error when creating the order.
column4: Every NOKIA answer to this environment's provisioning orders, with both test ONTs.
column5:
1. Coopeweb sends a new contract request.
2. Order Management > open the contract's provisioning order > enter the test ONT serial and model on the Internet service > create the order.
3. Open the customer > Customer Activity and check the NOKIA steps in order: location lookup (GET_LOCATION_DATA), free position (GET_SPACE_DATA), configuration (CREATE_PROVISIONING_ORDER).
4. Open the order and check its status.
Expected: every NOKIA step answers successfully and the order ends COMPLETED.
column6: Reproduced, in two stages. With the first test ONT (ALCLB3D9363D, shared with the CoopeG Sandbox), NOKIA refused the location lookup, so nothing else could be sent. With the second test ONT (ALCLB3D94488, 26 Oct, contracts QA-ANH-NS-R2-10261514-E108 and QA-ANH-NS-R2-10261545-E108), NOKIA finds the ONT and proposes position 8 (OLT-STC01, 1-1-1-1-8) as free, then refuses to configure the ONT there: "Could not configure ISAM ONT on 1-1-1-1-8 ... Unable to create object" (NOKIA rolled back). The order ends PROVISIONING_ERROR and Embrix reports the failure to Coopeweb. Resolved in the environment: since 31 Oct NOKIA configures the test ONT ALCLB3D94488 on OLT-STC01 (operative status ENABLED, test contract 798696), so the provisioning order is created and completed.
column8: Integration / test data (NOKIA test system): this environment and the Demo Sandbox use the same NOKIA test system, which still held the test ONT's position, and the test environment lacked 7 OLT templates that production has. No Embrix code change.
column9: Done in the environment: the position was freed in NOKIA and the OLT templates were copied from production (31 Oct). Keep one environment provisioning with a test ONT at a time.
